description: This file defines the SubPanelViewNotes class, which manages the display and interaction logic for the notes subpanel within a SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for setting notes data, rendering the subpanel header, and processing the list view for notes.

classes.name: SubPanelViewNotes
classes.description: A class that provides the view logic for the notes subpanel, including rendering headers and lists, and managing note data.

methods.name: setFocus
methods.description: Sets the focus object for the subpanel, typically representing the current record.

methods.name: setNotesList
methods.description: Assigns the list of notes to be displayed in the subpanel.

methods.name: setHideNewButton
methods.description: Controls the visibility of the 'New' button in the subpanel.

methods.name: getHeaderText
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the subpanel header, including the 'New' button.

methods.name: ProcessSubPanelListView
methods.description: Initializes and processes the list view for displaying notes in the subpanel, including setting templates and header info.
